newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CCT Telecom up on Xinhua's participation.
newsitem.headline: CCT Telecom up on Xinhua's participation.

text.p: Shares of CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd bucked weak market sentiment and rose on hopes of stronger growth potential after China's Xinhua News Agency ageed to take a strategic stake in the company, brokers said on Wednesday.
"News that Xinhua would take a stake in the company led to an anticipation of the company business to benefit from Xinhua's connection in China," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
CCT shares rose HK$0.16 or 30.77 percent to HK$0.68 in late morning after they repeated its 12 months high of HK$0.74. Volume was 227.56 million shares worth HK$154.20 million.
CCT Telecom had said earlier it would place 200 million new shares, or 12.51 percent of its enlarged share capital, to a commercial arm of Xinhua News Agency at HK$0.42 each.
Xinhua's Hong Kong branch is China's de facto consulate in the territory.
